title: valeriana officinalis var. sambucifolia
intro: Valeriana officinalis var. sambucifolia, commonly known as Sambucine valerian or Elder Valerian, is a variety of the valerian plant that is native to certain parts of Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include a range of health benefits such as relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness, as well as its potential to reduce muscle spasms and menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Sambucine valerian include sedative, anxiolytic, and antispasmodic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including valepotriates and valerenic acids. The plant's bioactive constituents are also responsible for its adaptogenic properties, allowing it to promote balance and well-being in the body.
